spatial_and_orientation_analysis: Reference and delivered render both place a blue three-seat sofa against the back, a forward right chaise, a foreground table and rug, a low white unit left, a cupboard and lamp right, and tall shelving at the right edge. Evidence: reference and delivered candidate images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:16-68.

The candidate shows more of the room and complete table while the reference crops the table and right shelf strongly; the sofa, left artwork and right shelving occupy smaller screen proportions in the candidate. Camera framing, lens, furniture sizes and layout are coupled, so these observations do not isolate the cause. Candidate camera is at (0,-5.45,3.35), lens 27: /evidence/final_source/build.py:80.

Sofa cushions face toward the table and camera; cabinet door fronts and shelves face approximately toward the room in the reconstruction. The reference establishes broad visible faces, not exact hidden orientations. The upper back-wall GT object is a window (instance 92), while the student modeled a mirror; this is a visual-position correspondence with a semantic mismatch, not proof of a real mirror. /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:329-343; /evidence/final_source/build.py:60-64.

Absolute 3D position, orientation and scale errors are not estimated; no aligned coordinate system is established. Repeated and hidden parts are uncertain. /app/input_index.json:33; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:490.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The reference has subtle directional wood grain and diagonal streaks on the glossy table; candidate shelving is comparatively flat-colored and the tabletop has straight, evenly spaced lengthwise stripes. Candidate code makes 'Light natural oak' a plain material and 'Table inlay' strips real meshes: /evidence/final_source/build.py:5-6,15,38-46,56-59.

mat edits the default Principled BSDF base color, roughness and metallic values, rather than constructing a texture coordinate, mapping or image texture path; material bindings are appended by box and cylinder. The directional library's Object-to-Multiply-to-Noise-to-Ramp-to-Principled-to-Output chain is distinct and not called: /evidence/final_source/build.py:5-13; /evidence/available_library/reconstruct.py:88-114. No texture mapping direction or scale is applicable to those plain materials.

Lighting is a tinted world plus one large area light, Cycles and AgX: /evidence/final_source/build.py:77-82. Single-view illumination and albedo are not independently identifiable. The source constructs wall-art shapes as local object meshes rather than a full-reference image plane: build.py:69-76. Evaluator summary reports no missing external images: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:3-7; packed-image status was not independently inspected.
